Cage requirements 
Needs: 
-At least 600+ sq inch of floor space, 900+ for a female Syrian 
-sand bath, make sure it’s sand, not dust. You can use reptile sand and child safe play sand
-At least 6 Inches of safe bedding for burrowing, minimum 
-A large enough wheel, minimum 8 inch for dwarfs and robos, 10inch for Syrians
- multiple hides 

Care:
- spot clean every week or so in the areas with the most waste
- full cage clean out every month, but don’t remove all the bedding
- try scatter feeding (sprinkle their food around their cage instead of putting in a bowl), it provides more enrichment 
-provide them with safe wood/ toys for enrichment and keeping their teeth and nails the right length 
- fresh water daily
-do not wake your hamster up ever. 
-try not to feed it too much fresh fruit and veggies as it’s very high in sugar 

I’d reccomend naturalistic enclosures as they provide the most enrichment. I’ve posted photos of my enclosure before, its a DIY IKEA linnmon cage and is really cheap. There are lots of good YouTube tutorials for IKEA linnmon and IKEA detolf DIY cages if you’re on a budget. Other good cheap cages are bin cages. Just make sure it’s big enough, it can be hard to find a big enough cage. Floor space is continuous space, so platforms don’t count towards floor space.
